# Demo photo sources

These images are used only by the isolated visual-regression environment and README screenshots. They are excluded from installable theme archives.

All four photographs are available for commercial and non-commercial use under the [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license). Attribution is included here for provenance even though the license does not require it.

- `mountain-lake.jpg` — [Adriel Kloppenburg](https://unsplash.com/photos/EKIyHUrUHWU)
- `autumn-road.jpg` — [Tadeusz Lakota](https://unsplash.com/photos/WfYedPKs-R8)
- `forest-road.jpg` — [James Francis](https://unsplash.com/photos/CBW_YxHSQ3Y)
- `alpine-lake.jpg` — [DEENOW](https://unsplash.com/photos/kblRqsIVebw)

The checked-in copies are resized and recompressed for deterministic tests. Do not replace them with photos whose redistribution terms are unclear.
